title: NASA Cancels Its Rescue Mission for the Aging Swift Telescope
summary: A robotic mission would catch up to Swift, capture it with mechanical arms, and use its own thrusters to raise the observatory to a safer orbit, where it could continue operating. LINK will no longer capture Swift or raise its orbit.
